portal_perks.summary: VMORC perks. Body must include siteId + a populated perkTypeRequests array (one entry per perk type); the old siteId+pageRequest-only body fails with 400/500. Fixed and verified 2026-09-14 via network capture + JS bundle inspection of visa.com.lk/en_lk/visa-offers-and-perks/ (public page, no auth) — confirmed 200 with no cookies via plain curl, so this is a genuinely stateless public endpoint.
